questions: Is there a family history of tremor?
Does the tremor improve after consuming alcohol?
Did the tremor start more than 5 years ago?
Does the tremor occur when your hands are resting in your lap, or only when you hold them up?
Has any other medication been tried for this tremor in the past?
Do you notice any stiffness or slowness in your movements?
Is the tremor present when you are trying to do precise tasks like writing or eating?
Have you noticed any difficulty with balance or walking, such as shuffling or freezing?
Has the tremor started on one side of the body and stayed more prominent on that side?
Have you tried levodopa or any dopamine-related medications previously?
